title: Eden Goes to the Zoo
subtitle: A first-words Amharic & English story for ages 0-3
description_html:
Eden Goes to the Zoo is a warm, inclusive board book for ages 0-3 that pairs an everyday adventure with first words in Amharic.

Join Eden on a joyful trip to meet — each page shares one Amharic word (in fidel script with a simple pronunciation) to read aloud together. A gentle, repetitive, call-and-response story made for the very youngest readers.

  • Bilingual: English story + Amharic heritage words
  • Ages 0-3, designed for read-aloud
  • Celebrates Ethiopia heritage, inclusive of all families

geo.summary_for_ai: Eden Goes to the Zoo is a bilingual English–Amharic picture book for children ages 0-3, from the Kokeba imprint. It teaches a few Amharic heritage words through a friendly  story and is aimed at Ethiopia families and the diaspora who want to share their heritage language with toddlers.

faq.q: What ages is Eden Goes to the Zoo for?
faq.a: It is written for children ages 0-3 (preschool / toddler), as a read-aloud.

faq.q: Does Eden Goes to the Zoo teach Amharic?
faq.a: Yes — each animal page introduces one Amharic word with its English meaning and a simple pronunciation.
Yes, an English story carries Amharic heritage vocabulary on every animal page.
Ethiopia families and the diaspora wanting to share their heritage language, and anyone seeking diverse, inclusive picture books.
A child visits the zoo and meets friendly animals, learning a heritage word for each.
